hypothesis: The deployable coarse joint model and manually marginalized fine-type models leave the large fine-pitch oracle headroom unused. A single classifier over control outcome times eight matched historical fine pitch types can learn the joint distribution directly and obtain P(success|x) by summing success classes, avoiding a separately multiplied selector and fine-type effect estimate.

novelty_relative_to_closed_axes.fine_pitch_latent: Previously estimated fine-type effects and manually multiplied them by a selector.
novelty_relative_to_closed_axes.fine_pitch_probability_features: Previously supplied OOF fine probabilities to an ordinary exact-C outcome model.
novelty_relative_to_closed_axes.dense_pitch_joint: Previously modeled only three counter-reconstructed coarse groups.
novelty_relative_to_closed_axes.this_candidate: Uses matched fine type as a historical auxiliary joint label and learns the fine-type/control marginal in one proper multiclass objective.

source_protocol.ranking: maximize minimum R gain, then minimum full gain, then mean R gain, then prefer smaller gamma
source_protocol.on_fail: Close without reading 2022, 2023, or 2024 candidate metrics.
source_protocol.on_pass: Lock the selected gamma, then rerun fresh 2022/2023 development folds.

candidate.fine_probability_semantics: Three-fold row-id-hash OOF for labeled history; three-model average for unmatched history and validation.
candidate.prediction: Sum all learned joint-class probabilities whose class starts with success|.
